title: Scaling factors
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, let $h$ be the number of pairs consisting of an optional state of $N$ and one of three head positions, and put $W=h+3k+1$, where $k$ is the number of tapes. Define the scaling factors for $E,F,E2,F2,In,C$ to be respectively $4W,2,4W,2,2,2W$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
